title: Expect the Unexpected
description: It's an expert pack, after all...
§2Druidic Quest§r strives to give you a wholly unique experience in Minecraft!  While you may recognize many mods included in this modpack, there is much that may surprise you along the way.
With comprehensive mod-integration enhanced by exclusive content, §2Druidic Quest§r will push you to innovate new methods of automation by mixing the powers of magic and machinery!
